Jordan (People Ops): :wave: Quick heads-up — we've got a reviewer gap in APAC for the final review week (Mar 30–Apr 3). Need to reassign ~6 review bundles and confirm late-exception flow for folks on short-term LOA. Plan below, plus a sheet to sign up for swaps.

Priya Rao: Thanks — what's the expected reviewer time commitment per bundle?

Jordan (People Ops): ~90m average but can vary (some are 45m, some 2h). We're prioritizing reviewers local to APAC evenings to avoid cross-midnight handoffs. If you can take 1–2 bundles, drop your name in the sheet.

Sam Lee: I can take 2 bundles (GMT+8 evenings ok).

Tanya Patel: Link to sheet? I can cover 1 bundle on Mon/Tue.

Jordan (People Ops): Sheet here: https://docs.google.com/sheet/d/APAC-reviewer-swap (view+edit for People Ops team). Please add: Name | bundles | preferred days | EXT tag if you need an exception. Example row: `Sam Lee, 2, Mon/Tue evening,`

Jordan (People Ops): Quick CSV export snippet if you want to bulk upload reviewer assignments: 
```
reviewer_name,reviewer_email,bundles_assigned,timezone_tag,notes
Sam Lee,sam@redwood.ai,2,GMT+8,"pref evening"
Tanya Patel,tanya@redwood.ai,1,GMT+5:30,"Mon only"
```

People Ops Bot: Reminder — review submission forms close in 48 hours for the APAC final window. If you need an approved extension, submit the exception request form: https://redwood.internal/exception-request. :alarm_clock: 

Mara Ortiz: I need an extension — caregiver pickup conflict on Apr 1 morning. What's the cutoff for approvals?

Jordan (People Ops): Hi Mara — we can approve short extensions up to 7 days for caregiving if manager signs off. Please file via the exception form and CC your manager. Use reason code `CARE-APAC` and we'll fast-track. If you want, I can pre-fill the manager approval email template for you.

Mara Ortiz: Filing now. Tagging @Priya for manager sign-off.

Priya Rao: Approved, marked in sheet with `EXT-APAC` tag. Thanks for the heads up.

Sam Lee: Noted — I can pick up one of Mara's bundles on Apr 2 evening. Added to sheet.

Jordan (People Ops): Awesome — updated the roster. Two operational notes: 1) Please add `EXT-APAC` to any row that used the exception form. 2) If you're taking overflow bundles, set a Slack reminder: `/remind me to finish review 2 hours before shift` or ping #eng-oncall if you hit infra issues.

Tanya Patel: Quick Q — do manager-evaluations need separate sign-off if reviewer had an exception?

Jordan (People Ops): Yes — manager finalization still required. Exception only affects the deadline. We'll run a small calibration sync Thurs 9am UTC to spot-check scoring drift from late reviews. Invite sent to everyone in the sheet.

People Ops Bot: Event created: "Calibration sync — APAC late-review check" Thu 09:00 UTC. RSVP list pulled from sheet.

Jordan (People Ops): Closing the loop: roster shows all bundles assigned, one pending exception approved (Mara), and two overflow signups. If anyone else can cover an extra bundle, please update within the next 2 hours. :thumbsup:

Sam Lee: I can take one more if needed.

Jordan (People Ops): Thanks all — will post final roster CSV in the sheet and send a follow-up summary after the calibration. Appreciate the quick responses.
